definitions.explanation: A group of warships organized under a single commander for military operations. Used in both historical and modern military contexts, as well as in science fiction and gaming.

examples.japanese: {艦隊|かんたい}が{出港|しゅっこう}した。
{連合|れんごう}{艦隊|かんたい}は{太平洋|たいへいよう}で{大|おお}きな{海戦|かいせん}を{戦|たたか}った。
examples.english: The combined fleet fought a major naval battle in the Pacific.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}では、{宇宙|うちゅう}{艦隊|かんたい}が{未知|みち}の{惑星|わくせい}に{向|む}かって{旅立|たびだ}つ{壮大|そうだい}な{物語|ものがたり}が{描|えが}かれている。
examples.english: This movie depicts a grand story of a space fleet setting off toward an unknown planet.

notes:
USAGE:
Originally a military term but widely known through historical education, war films, and popular culture. The word gained widespread modern recognition through the game franchise {艦隊|かんたい}これくしょん (KanColle). Also commonly used in science fiction for space fleets.

HISTORICAL NOTE:
The {連合|れんごう}{艦隊|かんたい} (Combined Fleet) was the main fleet of the Imperial Japanese Navy and features prominently in Japanese World War II history.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連合|れんごう}{艦隊|かんたい}: combined fleet
- {艦隊|かんたい}{司令官|しれいかん}: fleet commander
- {宇宙|うちゅう}{艦隊|かんたい}: space fleet
